llm_response.reason: The website at 'desiguals.ro' pretends to be an "Acne Studios Outlet" targeting Austrian consumers but is registered under a Romanian (.ro) domain with a registration date in mid-2025 (extremely recent). The navigation redirects to another suspicious domain (acnestudios.co.at) that is not associated with the legitimate Acne Studios (acnestudios.com). Search results show many scam issues connected to similarly named fake Acne Studios sites selling counterfeit or nonexistent goods, with user reports of fraud. The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: brand spoofing, country and domain mismatch, links to non-official domains, and anomalous registration and setup procedures. All evidence indicates this is a fake online shopping scam.
